title: SYNTHETIC Community-Acquired Pneumonia Protocol
synthetic_notice: SYNTHETIC protocol for CKEA demonstration only. Not real guidance.

sections.section_text: Give amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily for 5 days to adults with low-severity community-acquired pneumonia.
Give clarithromycin 500 mg twice daily for 5 days if the patient has a penicillin allergy.
Avoid clarithromycin in patients taking simvastatin because of the risk of myopathy.
